content_sections.heading: ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ACTREC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Diesel Mechanic: SSC pass with ITI in Diesel Mechanic (1-year course) from Govt. recognized Institution / NCVT certificate with 3 years' experience in handling of D.G. Sets and other electromechanical equipment's. Willing to work in shift duties including nights, Sundays and Holidays. Preference will be given to candidate worked with OEM.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Age Limit
content_sections.text: Diesel Mechanic: Maximum age limit is 33 years. Age relaxation may be provided on the basis of experience.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Diesel Mechanic: Consolidated salary of Rs. 26,210 to 35,000/- p.m.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for ACTREC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the ACTREC Recruitment 2026 is Diesel Mechanic. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Diesel Mechanic post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Diesel Mechanic post in the ACTREC Recruitment 2026. Interested candidates should ensure they meet all the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the ACTREC Diesel Mechanic position?
faq.answer: This recruitment is through a walk-in interview, so there is no specific last date for online application. Candidates must attend the interview on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Diesel Mechanic role?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Diesel Mechanic position ranges from ₹ 26,210 to ₹ 35,000/- per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Diesel Mechanic post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC and possess an ITI in Diesel Mechanic (1-year course) from a government-recognized institution or an NCVT certificate.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any experience required for the Diesel Mechanic position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have 3 years of experience in handling D.G. Sets and other electromechanical equipment's. Preference will be given to those who have worked with OEM.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Diesel Mechanic post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Diesel Mechanic post is 33 years. However, this limit may be relaxed based on the candidate's experience.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the ACTREC Diesel Mechanic job?
faq.answer: The application process is a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report at the specified venue on the interview date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for ACTREC Diesel Mechanic Recruitment 2026 scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Ground Floor, Pushp Building, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhar Card, PAN CARD, ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification mark sheets, certificates, and experience certificates.
